description:
Upgrade your boat's helm with a custom carbon fiber switch panel built to look as good as it performs. This panel holds 8 switches and is machined from 1/8" (3mm) carbon fiber for a clean, modern look that outlasts stock plastic and corroded aluminum. No more faded, cracked, or rusted panels dragging down your dash, just tight tolerances, sharp edges, and a finish that turns heads at the dock.

Need a different switch count or panel size? We machine every panel to custom dimensions, so it fits your exact layout instead of the other way around.
story: A corroded, bent factory switch panel on a customer's boat was the spark for this one: we machined a carbon fiber replacement that won't rust, warp, or look dated again.
